title: Developer Sparkline Walkthrough Canvas — compact onboarding panels for auth, streaming & tool calls
creator: Maya Chen
description: Create a compact, modular set of onboarding panels ("sparkline" canvas) for API/SDK docs and release pages that illustrate: 1) API key + token rotation flows, 2) streaming response lifecycle (init / partial / final), 3) tool-calling sequence (register -> invoke -> response), and 4) breathable code + screenshot pairings for copy in the docs. Deliverables: Figma components, exported PNG/SVG assets (light + dark), annotated specs for engineering and docs, and a small animated GIF for the quickstart hero. Prioritize small file sizes and reusability across docs, console, and marketing release notes.
acceptance_criteria: Figma master file contains component variants for: Desktop / Mobile / Narrow (docs inline)
Exports: PNG @2x, SVG optimized, and 480x240 GIF for hero
All panels include accessible labels and short alt text snippets in the spec sheet
Engineering has a single-page spec (image + token rotation microcopy) and one linked example PR
Illustrations pass PM visual review and match brand color palette (light/dark)
Assets optimized to <= 150KB for hero GIF, <= 40KB per inline SVG where possible
